title: hello (connector -> runtime)
description: First frame on a new connection. Identifies the connector, authenticates (if no Authorization header was sent), declares capabilities and optionally asks to resume a previous session.

pcp.description: Highest PCP version the connector speaks, MAJOR.MINOR. MAJOR must match the WebSocket subprotocol (pcp.v1 -> 1).

id.description: Stable connector instance id, configured in the admin console (one per platform account).

kind.description: chat (default), audio (audiohook), bridge (talks to a bridge hub, 1.1 semantics: sends hello.data.bridge), or other.

platform_version.description: Version of the platform client/API the connector drives (e.g. Camfrog client build).

host.description: Free-form host label for logs. Never an address.

self.description: The bot's own account on the platform, if known yet.

auth.description: Only when the transport could not send an Authorization header.

bridge.description: (1.1) Sent by connectors with kind=bridge, whose runtime is a bridge hub that relays lines between platforms.

echo_correlation.description: How the connector ties the platform echo of a relayed line to its action: job (an intermediate queue's job id), label (a platform request label, e.g. IRCv3 labeled-response), nonce (a platform send nonce).

delivery_ack.description: When the send result is final: on_wire (written to the platform) or on_echo (the platform echoed it back).

history_backfill.description: The connector can fetch platform history after an outage.

policy_ttl_ms.description: Age after which the connector treats its policy.sync mirror as stale (spec/PCP.md, Security and privacy).

result_cache.description: durable: the action result cache survives a connector restart for the replay window, so the connector may resume after a restart. volatile: it does not, so after a process restart the connector starts a new session instead of resuming. Every accepted resume gets its unfinished actions re-sent (spec/PCP.md, Resume).

resume.description: Resume a previous session after a disconnect.

last_seq_sent.description: Highest seq the connector sent before the drop (informational).

buffer_from_seq.description: Lowest seq still held in the connector's replay buffer.
